The main takeaway from our work is that

a single field model of inflation can explain the BICEP2 data with a sub-Plancky excursion of the inflating field, and we can constrain the potential in a sub-Planky regime in a model independent manner.

a sub-Plankian excursion of the field, which is consistent with the current observational bounds, can yield a large tensor-to-scalar ratio and can be used to reconstruct the inflation in a model independent manner.
